items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Angela Dean, who has been very good to me.

ctx.x: Do you have any favorite designers?

These days – well, Angela Dean, who has been very good to me. B. Michael. I used to love Halston. And that’s – what’s the guy’s name who used to do Halston? He’s got his own, and he – oh, wow, I can’t think of his name. Cannot think of his name.
You’re out of my league now.
